claude_only.name: Which identifier identifies this quality assertion itself, as distinct from the subject it describes and the measure it applies?
Is this record a computed measurement, a human quality annotation, a certificate, a policy statement, or user feedback?
What natural key determines whether two records are the same assertion rather than two independent assessments of the same subject?
Who is authorised to mint and retire identifiers for quality assertions within the adopting Dimension?
What exactly was assessed: the whole resource, a distribution, a subset, a field, or a single instance?
Does the assertion apply only within a restricted extent, population segment, or operating condition, and how is that restriction expressed?
Was the whole scope inspected or was a sample used to infer a property of a population?
May one assertion cover several subjects at once, and if so how is per-subject traceability preserved?
Which dimension vocabulary is bound for this subject class, at which version, and by whose authority?
Is the dimension inherent to the data itself or dependent on the surrounding system and context of use?
Which dimensions are mandatory for this subject class before it may be published or relied upon, and which are optional?
Where two bound vocabularies define overlapping or contradictory dimensions, which one governs?
Which registered measure produced this value, at which version, and where is its definition dereferenceable?
What parameters, tolerances or thresholds were bound when the measure was applied, and what are their values?
What value type and value structure does the measure emit — a single value, a ratio, a count, a matrix, or a coverage?
How is a measure superseded or retired, and what happens to results already produced by the retired version?
Which documented procedure and which tool version executed this assessment?
If sampling was used, what was the sampling design, the achieved sample size, and the resulting representativeness claim?
Was the assessment automated, human-judged, or hybrid, and where did human judgement enter?
What preprocessing, exclusion or filtering was applied before measurement, and could it bias the result?
Against which reference, specification or ground truth was the subject compared, and who adjudicated it?
Is there an unbroken documented chain relating this result to a stated reference, and where is it recorded?
What is known about the quality and error rate of the reference itself?
If no independent reference exists, how is that stated so the result is not read as accuracy?
What is the result value and what data type and value structure does it use?
What scale type applies, and which arithmetic operations are therefore invalid on this value?
If the value is a quantity, which dereferenceable unit identifier applies?
What is the permitted value domain, and how are null, not-applicable and not-assessed distinguished from a poor score?
What uncertainty is attached to the result, expressed as a standard uncertainty, an expanded uncertainty, or an interval?
How was the uncertainty evaluated, and which components dominate the budget?
If no uncertainty was evaluated, why not, and what interpretation is thereby forbidden?
How is the uncertainty of the value kept distinct from the confidence in the assertion as a whole?
What is this confidence statement about: the assertion, the underlying value, the method, or the subject?
Is the confidence value a probability, and if not, what is it?
What action is an agent permitted or forbidden to take at each confidence level?
Where the subject is a model output that carries its own score, is that score treated as confidence, and is it calibrated?
Which confidence scale is used, at which version, and where are its ordered terms defined?
Is there an authorised numeric mapping for the scale terms, and is cross-scale comparison permitted?
What evidence supports a claim that numeric confidence values are calibrated, and when was it last established?
How is an uncalibrated confidence value marked so downstream agents do not treat it as a probability?
What type and amount of evidence underpins this assertion, and how consistent is it?
How much do independent assessors, methods or sources agree, and how was agreement measured?
Which factors lowered or raised the confidence rating, and what is the recorded reason for each adjustment?
What evidence that would materially change the rating is known to be missing or inaccessible?
Which retrievable evidence items substantiate this assertion, and what does each one show?
How is the integrity of each evidence item protected and verified at retrieval time?
What is needed to re-execute this assessment and reproduce the result within stated tolerance?
If no evidence is retained, is the assertion explicitly marked as an unsubstantiated judgement?
Is any evidence item access-restricted, and what may a consumer be told when they cannot retrieve it?
What acceptance limit applies to this measure, in which direction, and who set it?
How does the decision rule account for measurement uncertainty when comparing the result to the limit?
On what basis was the threshold chosen — regulation, contract, product specification, or internal convention?
What happens to existing verdicts when a threshold changes?
What is the verdict, against which requirement, and using which result?
What severity is attached to each non-conformance, and what does that severity oblige the consumer to do?
Is the verdict reproducible from the recorded result, requirement and decision rule alone?
How are partial, conditional or waived conformance states represented without collapsing them into pass?
For which stated purpose was fitness judged, and by whom?
Is the subject judged fit, fit with conditions, or unfit for that purpose, and on which assertions does the judgement rest?
What known defects, exclusions or systematic errors are present that a consumer must be told about?
Which uses does this assessment explicitly not support, and where is that recorded so it travels with the data?
What happens to the fitness judgement when the intended purpose changes?
Which state of the subject, at which instant or interval, does this assertion describe?
When was the assessment executed and when did its result become available?
When was the assertion recorded or ingested into the adopting Dimension, and how does that differ from the result time?
What time precision and clock source are used, and is the precision adequate for the decisions taken on this assertion?
From when until when may this assertion be relied upon?
What must a consuming agent do when the assertion is past its validity window?
How often must this measure be re-assessed, and what events force early re-assessment?
Does quality on this dimension decay predictably over time, and is that decay modelled or merely assumed?
What are the permitted lifecycle states of an assertion and which transitions are legal?
Is this record a correction of a defective assertion or an independent new assessment?
What guarantees that an issued assertion is not altered after the fact, and how is that verifiable?
When an assertion is retracted, what must happen to decisions and derived assertions that relied on it?
Which agent produced this assertion, in which role, and on whose behalf?
Under what authority, accreditation or delegated mandate is this assertion issued?
What is the assessor's relationship to the subject's owner, and is any conflict of interest declared?
What evidence supports the assessor's competence for this specific measure?
From which assertions, datasets or activities was this assertion derived?
If this is a composite or rolled-up score, what function and weights produced it and who approved them?
Are the inputs on compatible scales and scopes such that aggregation is meaningful?
Can a consumer recover the dimension-level results behind a composite score?
How does an assertion about an input propagate to products derived from that input?
To which external term does each slot of this model map, and at what mapping strength?
Is conformance to a cited standard claimed, and what test evidence supports the claim?
Which known conflicts or semantic mismatches exist between aligned standards, and how are they resolved?
How are mappings maintained when an aligned standard is revised?
Under what stated conditions may two results of this measure be compared or trended?
Which combinations of scales, units or confidence vocabularies are explicitly forbidden from being combined?
How is a break in comparability caused by a method or threshold change signalled to consumers?
When results are normalised for comparison, what normalisation was applied and is it reversible?
Which other assertions cover the same subject, scope and dimension, and do they conflict?
What precedence rule applies when assertions conflict, and who owns that rule?
How does an affected party challenge an assertion, and what outcomes and deadlines apply?
Where the assertion concerns personal data, what rectification or erasure duty applies and how is it evidenced?
While a dispute is open, how is the assertion's disputed status made visible to consumers?
What access classification applies to this assertion, and does it differ from that of the subject?
What may a consumer without full access be told, and what must never be inferable from the redacted view?
Which limitations must be disclosed regardless of classification because they affect safety, rights or legal duties?
Is the assertion under embargo before a scheduled release, and who may lift it?
How long must this assertion and each of its evidence artifacts be retained, and on what basis?
When evidence must be deleted but the assertion must survive, what is retained and what is destroyed?
How is an erasure request affecting quality evidence executed and evidenced without falsifying the audit trail?
What suspends scheduled deletion, who may impose and release a hold, and how is the hold recorded?
How is a conflict between a mandatory retention duty and an erasure duty resolved and documented?

grok_only.name: What is the authoritative master-system identifier of this quality assertion, and which identifier scheme (governed IRI, UUID or ULID) is used if no master identifier exists?
Is this record a measurement, annotation, certificate, policy binding, metadata container, or a derived composite statement?
Which version or revision of the quality statement is this, and which prior statement is it a revision of?
In which language or languages are labels and narrative quality comments provided?
Which host resource or resources is this quality statement about, using the host's authoritative identifier?
Is the statement about the host data, about the host's metadata, or about a previous quality statement (quality of quality)?
If the host is only a subset, partition, distribution or linkset, what subset definition binds the evaluation?
Does the evaluation target a geographic extent or spatial object set, and in which spatial reference is that extent stated?
What is the identifier, preferred label and definition of the quality dimension being measured or annotated?
Which category or categories group this dimension, and is multiple categorisation intentional?
Which concept scheme or standard catalogue owns this dimension code?
Is this dimension treated as inherent to the data, system-dependent, or both, in the chosen catalogue?
Which ISO/IEC 25012 characteristic, if any, does this dimension align to, using the official characteristic name?
What context of use is assumed when applying the ISO/IEC 25012 definition?
If uniqueness or validity is required by the adopting community, is it modelled as an extension rather than claimed as an ISO/IEC 25012 characteristic?
If confidentiality, accessibility or availability is selected, has the sibling access or privacy model been referenced instead of treating those scores as sufficient access control?
Which ISO 19157-1 data-quality element and sub-element, if any, does this dimension map to?
If a usability or fitness rating is recorded, is it modelled as an extension or policy outcome rather than as a 2023 core element?
What measure reference, evaluation method type and reporting descriptor are used for this geographic quality element?
Was a domain-specific quality component added under the ISO 19157-1 extension process, and who authorised it?
Which known mapping conflicts apply to this dimension (uniqueness, usability, precision versus uncertainty, credibility versus confidence, fitness versus intrinsic accuracy)?
Is this dimension's applicability declared as intrinsic, or only as fitness for a stated purpose under ISO 8000 principles?
Which local profile or concept scheme is canonical for this Dimension when catalogues disagree?
What identifier and definition distinguish this extension dimension from standard catalogue codes?
Who authorised the extension and against which standard extension clause?
If an ISO/IEC 5259-2 additional ML characteristic is claimed, is the official characteristic name cited from the standard text rather than inferred?
What is the identifier, definition and owning dimension of this metric?
What expected datatype and allowed value range or enumeration does the metric declare?
What unit of measure, if any, applies, and which unit system IRI is referenced?
Is this metric derived from another metric, and if so from which?
Is the evaluation direct or indirect, internal or external, automated, manual or mixed, and which procedure identifier is used?
Which metric parameters (thresholds inside the method, language, property path, test-set identifier) were bound for this run?
Was the method or result independently reviewed, and by whom?
Which software agent or human agent executed the evaluation?
What is the observed value, its datatype, unit and scale type (ratio, interval, ordinal, nominal, boolean)?
Does a larger numeric value mean better quality for this metric, and what is the theoretically best or worst value?
If the result is qualitative, which controlled code or ordinal label was assigned and by which scheme?
If no value could be computed (empty host, missing reference, failed run), what exception code explains the missing score?
Which source measurements, metrics or annotations were used to derive this result?
What weights, operators or rules combined the inputs, and are those weights disclosed?
Which trustworthiness or quality trade-offs were accepted when producing the composite, and who decided?
Is this score a roll-up across partitions, and is homogeneity or disaggregation available for those partitions?
What is the standard or combined standard uncertainty of this result, in which unit, and was evaluation Type A, Type B or both?
Which input quantities and uncertainty components form the uncertainty budget?
Does the GUM linearised model apply, or is a different uncertainty evaluation (for example Monte Carlo as in later JCGM documents) used?
If the quality result is ordinal or nominal, how is uncertainty expressed without falsely quoting a GUM expanded uncertainty?
What expanded uncertainty, coverage factor, coverage probability and interval bounds accompany this result?
What probability distribution or approximation justifies the coverage factor?
Is the reported figure labelled as coverage probability, GUM level of confidence, or a statistical confidence interval, and is that label justified?
If an interval is reported without k or coverage probability, what exception or incompleteness is recorded?
What metaquality confidence is assigned to this quality result, and on what evidence?
How representative of the declared quality unit is the evaluated sample or census?
Is quality homogeneous across the unit, or do partitions differ enough that a single score is misleading?
Who assessed metaquality, and is that party independent of the original assessor?
What predictive or rater confidence score was produced, on what scale, and is it claimed to be a calibrated probability?
Is a mapping to GUM coverage explicitly not claimed for this predictive score?
When was this confidence measure last calibrated or recalibrated against a representative test set, and what drift triggered it?
Are accuracy or confidence figures disaggregated for data segments relevant to expected use?
What is the identifier and definition of the data-quality unit evaluated?
What temporal extent of the host was evaluated, and is that distinct from the time the evaluation ran?
What spatial extent, if any, bounds the quality unit?
For streaming or continuously updated hosts, what sliding window or watermark defines currentness evaluation?
Was the evaluation a full census of the quality unit or a sample, and what was the sample size and design?
What sampling frame, inclusion rules and exclusion rules were used?
If the sample or unit was empty, what exception was raised instead of reporting 100 percent completeness?
Is the sample or test set representative of the conditions of expected use, including relevant segments?
For which stated purpose, user class and process is this quality claim made?
Who judged fitness for that purpose, and is the judgement a consumer annotation, a producer declaration, or a policy conformance result?
Are there declared purposes for which this host is explicitly not claimed to be fit?
Which data product specification or quality policy, if any, states minimum acceptable quality for this purpose?
What policy identifier, issuer, assignee and target host define this quality policy?
What metric, operator and threshold value constitute the duty or constraint?
Which quality dimensions does the policy govern?
Is the policy an open offer, a bilateral agreement, or an internal rule, and who may waive it?
To which standard, profile or policy is conformance claimed, and at which version?
What is the pass, fail or not-evaluated outcome, based on which measurements?
If non-conforming, which constraints failed and what exception or waiver applies?
Which required checks were not executed, and is untested distinct from pass?
What identifier, issuer, scheme and validity period apply to the referenced certificate?
Where is the certificate document stored, and what integrity hash binds it?
Which hosts, dimensions and sites does the certificate actually cover?
Has the certificate been revoked or suspended, when, and by whom?
What annotation motivation and body (rating, text, classification, question) does this feedback carry?
Who authored the annotation, in which role (producer, consumer, aggregator, certifier), and is the author independent?
Does this annotation conflict with other assessments of the same host and dimension, and how is disagreement recorded?
Are the annotator's identity and comment subject to privacy or access restrictions?
Which evidence items (logs, test outputs, samples, reviewer notes) support this quality statement?
What integrity hash, generation time and generating activity bind each evidence item?
Did the independent reviewer judge the evidence sufficient for the claimed outcome?
Which activity generated this quality record, started and ended at which RFC 3339 times?
Which agent is the quality record attributed to, and on whose behalf did they act?
Which procedures, test sets, reference data and prior measurements were used?
Which quality-metadata bundle or named graph contains this statement for joint provenance?
During which RFC 3339 interval is this quality statement intended to be used?
Has the statement been invalidated, by which activity, at what time, and for what reason?
What events (host version change, elapsed time, drift metric, incident) require re-evaluation?
Which newer statement supersedes this one for the same host, metric and scope?
Who may read this quality statement by default, and which scopes (bundle, layer, finding, artefact) are separately controlled?
Does this quality record reveal security, safety or personal data that requires tighter classification?
What retention period, legal hold and deletion method apply to the quality statement and its evidence pack?
Which audit events must be recorded for this quality record, and for how long?
Which local fields map to DQV classes and properties, and which DQV features are unimplemented?
Which local dimensions map to ISO/IEC 25012, ISO 19157-1 and ISO/IEC 5259-2 identifiers?
Is any formal conformance to those standards claimed, and if so where is the evidence?

requirements: Resolve every provider-only bundle, layer and finding against primary evidence.
Resolve the model boundary and entry kind before accepting structure.
Verify live URLs and version pins for all accepted sources.
Record every rejected and deferred node with a reason.
Do not publish while any critical conflict remains unresolved.
